summary.short_summary: The team discussed the sales pipeline, noting five scheduled calls with potential buyers before Christmas, ensuring progress despite typical year-end slowdowns. Efforts to enhance the Community Med opportunity, valued at £130,000–£150,000, were addressed, with plans to revamp messaging for better client engagement. The relationship with Query Click remains strained due to misaligned expectations and unclear financial reporting, complicating deal progress. Additionally, discrepancies in financial data from Pro Sales Finelite are being resolved, with updates anticipated soon. Andrew highlighted an upcoming meeting to secure £50 million in funding, aiming for a strategic shift towards self-financing acquisitions. Lastly, internal coordination issues were identified, emphasizing the need for clearer roles during client interactions to improve communication and reduce misunderstandings.
